About the therapist

Pavan M. Srivatsa

“Chakshu” means eye in Sanskrit. Chakshu Foundation was established in 2016 to help people connect with themselves through the inner eye.

Pavan M. Srivatsa is the founder and owner of Chakshu Foundation—a consulting psychologist, spiritual guide, author, case supervisor and public speaker working at the confluence of contemporary psychology and Indian knowledge systems.
